segments.title: Chương 19: Không thích anh đã lâu

Chapter 19: I Stopped Liking You a Long Time Ago

After evening self-study ended, the academic building was boisterous and filled with people, a clamor of voices.

Jiang Nian had packed up his things early and was about to walk out with his backpack slung over one shoulder. Just as he was about to find Xu Qianqian to go home together, as he always did, someone suddenly called out to him.

Jiang Nian glanced at Zhou Yuting in front of him. "Something you need?"

"Yeah." She was a head shorter than Jiang Nian and looked up at him. "There's something I want to talk to you about alone. Can you wait for me for a moment?"

Whenever Zhou Yuting lacked confidence, her eyes looked as if she'd suffered a terrible injustice, brimming with tears. One look was all it took for any boy, no matter how dissatisfied, to soften.

Showing weakness was one of her go-to tactics.

"It's about moving up to the advanced class, right? Let's just talk on our phones," Jiang Nian said, not wanting to waste time on her. He was about to walk past her. "If you haven't deleted me on QQ, that is."

Zhou Yuting instantly felt a pang of guilt and, in a flash, grabbed his white short-sleeved shirt.

"Wait."

"What are you doing?" Jiang Nian's expression was displeased, his tone unfriendly. "This is the classroom. Our classmates are all watching. Academic Rep, if you have something to say, just say it. Don't be so handsy."

What goes around comes around, you little bitch.

Didn't you love to smile? How come you're not smiling now that your spot in the advanced class is gone?

"Just for a little while. It won't take up too much of your time." Tears welled up in Zhou Yuting's eyes. She'd already deleted him on QQ, and besides, she couldn't leave a record of these words.

Jiang Nian scoffed, pushed her hand away, and turned to leave.

If you have no morals, you can't be morally blackmailed.

By the time he reached the classroom diagonally opposite his, Xu Qianqian was already waiting for him at the door. She was wearing her backpack, a light blue top, and dark-colored athletic pants.

"What took you so long?" she asked with a frown.

"It's nothing, let's go."

The two of them hadn't gotten far from the school gate when they were suddenly stopped. Zhou Yuting had actually chased after them.

"Jiang Nian, can we talk?"

This was a less crowded stretch of road, on the street outside the parking lot behind the mall. Under the streetlights, three surveillance cameras provided coverage. Jiang Nian used a shortcut key to turn on the voice recorder in his pocket.

"Sure, let's talk right here. I have to go home after you're done."

"Here..." Zhou Yuting glanced at Xu Qianqian, her face hesitant. "Hey classmate, could you please give us some space? It'll only take five minutes."

Just as Jiang Nian was about to speak, Xu Qianqian stepped back a few meters and crossed her arms to watch them.

"Go ahead and talk."

Jiang Nian: "..."

Zhou Yuting had an innocent face and a tall figure, but at this moment under the streetlight, she looked somewhat disheveled. Her lips parted slightly before she even spoke, and her eyes immediately turned red.

"The head teacher talked to me about moving up to the advanced class. I was next in line. But there's only one spot for our class, and I know you've had misunderstandings about me in the past."

"But I really need this chance to move up, Jiang Nian, I'm begging you."

"Even if you don't move up, you can still easily get into a top-tier university in the gaokao. I can't. I really want to get into Lu University, I really, really do. This is my only chance."

Jiang Nian looked at her expressionlessly. The streetlight stretched his shadow long, and his eyes were slightly downcast.

"You stopped me just to say this?"

"Yeah. Jiang Nian, you're the only one who can help me." Zhou Yuting was already crying, a trail of tears running down her fair face, looking utterly pitiful.

"What does that have to do with me?"

"What?"

"I said, what does that have to do with me?" Jiang Nian looked up, staring at her impassively, and could see the look of astonishment gradually appearing on her pitiful face.

"Your dream is your dream. What does it have to do with me moving up? If we were friends, there might be room for discussion, but unfortunately..."

"We are still friends. I just want to focus on studying right now, I don't want to be in a relationship yet," Zhou Yuting said anxiously. "We can be good friends first."

"Jiang Nian, you used to like me, right?"

"After the gaokao, I'll consider being your girlfriend, okay?"

"Please help me, okay? I'm begging you." Zhou Yuting's tears started falling again, crying a river under the streetlight. "Jiang Nian, I really don't know..."

"Sob, sob, sob... I really don't know what to do!"

As she spoke, Zhou Yuting tried to grab Jiang Nian's hand but he dodged it without a trace. She stared at her empty hand, standing frozen on the spot as the night wind messed up her long hair.

"Jiang Nian... I'm begging you."

From a short distance away, Xu Qianqian couldn't hear their voices clearly, but she could see Zhou Yuting crying and getting physical under the streetlight. For some reason, a mix of complicated feelings welled up in her heart.

Under the streetlight, Jiang Nian kept his distance from Zhou Yuting, his expression calm.

"Academic Rep, please have some self-respect."

The five minutes were almost up, and he didn't want to drag it out either.

What kind of bullshit was this? Saying she'll be my girlfriend after the gaokao. Does she take me for a fool? Simp for you for a year, just to watch you get a hotel room with someone else a month after the exam?

How much did she have to drink to dare say such picturesque words!

Should check her IP address and see if she's from Dunhuang.

How shameless does a person have to be to ask someone to give up their spot? Who asked you about your dream university? Whether you get into Lu University or some third-rate college is none of my damn business.

And she'll *consider* being my girlfriend? Are you ranking your first-choice college applications here?

Is that something a human being would say?

"What I said is all true, Jiang Nian. I really need this chance." Zhou Yuting looked like she was about to cry her little pearls again. "If you don't believe me, we can be a secret couple first."

"No, thank you, Academic Rep," Jiang Nian said seriously. "Once bitten, twice shy. I won't be friends with you again. I chose to move up to the advanced class precisely to get away from you."

"You can ask the head teacher to force the transfer; there's no need to beg me. As for your dream, Academic Rep, all I want to ask is, why didn't you say anything about it at the birthday party?"

"I stopped liking you a long time ago. It's been two months, you should have noticed. I have zero feelings for you. I just want to go to university and find a prettier upperclassman."

"You have absolutely no appeal, so don't bring up dating. Isn't your little clique very harmonious? Go play house by yourselves."

After speaking, Jiang Nian turned and walked away, not once looking back.

Under the streetlight, tear stains still fresh on her face, Zhou Yuting stood as if struck by lightning. Jiang Nian's words echoed in her mind over and over, and the more she thought, the more wronged she felt.

How could he be like this? She was the one who had humbled herself first!

She had even said she'd consider being with him after the gaokao. She had even disregarded her reputation as a girl and didn't look down on him for being poor, so what right did he have...

What right did he have to say he didn't like her!

Isn't love all about sacrificing for your other half? Isn't it all about going through trials and tests?

If Jiang Nian, who was already walking away with Xu Qianqian, had heard that, he definitely would have coughed up blood.

Test your mother! Simpleton!

On the way, Xu Qianqian kept her head down, clutching the strap of her backpack.

"What were you guys... talking about just now?"

"Oh, nothing much." Jiang Nian glanced at the girl beside him. "She was crying and saying she wanted to be my girlfriend, that she wanted to have a secret relationship with me."
